title: At home
aim: Say you live in a flat and name the rooms.
spainNote: In Spain, a flat is un piso. The floor of a building is also un piso.

turns.speaker: Luis
turns.english: Do you live in a flat?

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.spanish: Sí, vivo en un piso pequeño.
turns.english: Yes, I live in a small flat.

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.english: Yes, it has a kitchen and a living room.

turns.speaker: Ana
turns.spanish: El baño está allí. La llave está aquí.
turns.english: The bathroom is over there. The key is here.
